title: Normalized native open comparison at finite evaluation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and an open immersion j:U→X. Let a be any exact ordinary Open model and ea any OpenEvaluation for it [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Define integralNativeOpenIso as the left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism after transporting a.adj along integralNativePullIso [lem-sf-integral-native-direct-comparison]. For every system M and finite level n, evaluation of this specified isomorphism followed by native evalJ and the exact derived coordinate change compactSupportOpenModel [def-weil-compact-support-native-system-evaluation] equals ea.evaluation at M,n. This is an equality for the explicitly constructed comparison, including empty and identity opens, arbitrary unbounded systems and zero input; no compactification, proper image, integral input or chosen tower occurs.

proof.text: Use the fully proved integralNativePullEvaluation square, which identifies evaluation of integralNativePullIso followed by native evalG and the finite pullback coordinate change with the prescribed pullbackTensorDerivedEvaluation on all systems.

The defining left-adjoint uniqueness of compactSupportOpenModel gives its ordinary unit equation, using naturality of openSquarePullbackModel. Prove the generic localized_unit_transport formula from the public exact-localization unit formula and apply it to this equation, and exact_adjunction_eq from ExactClopenNormalization to identify the native levelJAdj with the exact localized adjunction. Apply the generic comparison-of-mates identity again, now to a.adj, native jAdj and the two finite open adjunctions. The transpose field of ea and the definition of evalJ.inv identify the two mates. This proves the stated equality on arbitrary derived systems, without faithfulness of evaluation. Empty and identity opens and zero input satisfy exactly the same unit identities.

theorem integralNativeOpenComparison {U X : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (a : Open l E j) (ea : OpenEvaluation l E a) :
    ∀ (M : System l E U) (n : ℕ),
      letI := sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_additive j
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
      letI := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_exact j
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).2.1
      letI := (sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero_exact j
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).2.2
      (coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
          ((integralNativeOpenIso l E j a).hom.app M) ≫
          (ProEtale.VaryingRing.evalJ (compactSupportSystemLevel l E)
            (compactSupportSystemQuotient l E) j n ≪≫
            Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
              (compactSupportOpenModel j
                (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))).hom.app M =
        (ea.evaluation n).hom.app M
